name: topk_route_stable
stmt:
theorem topk_route_stable (s s' : ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) (k : ℕ) (γ ε : ℝ)
    (hS : IsTopK s S k)
    (hgap : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → s j + γ ≤ s i)
    (hpert : ∀ j, |s' j - s j| ≤ ε)
    (hεγ : 2 * ε ≤ γ) :
    IsTopK s' S k
proof:
by
  refine ⟨hS.1, ?_⟩
  intro i hi j hj
  have h1 : s' j ≤ s j + ε := by
    have h := hpert j
    rw [abs_le] at h
    linarith [h.2]
  have h2 : s i - ε ≤ s' i := by
    have h := hpert i
    rw [abs_le] at h
    linarith [h.1]
  have h3 := hgap i hi j hj
  linarith

name: topk_route_stable_unique
stmt:
theorem topk_route_stable_unique (s s' : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) (γ ε : ℝ)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s j + γ ≤ s i)
    (hpert : ∀ j, |s' j - s j| ≤ ε)
    (hεγ : 2 * ε < γ) :
    ∀ j : ι, IsArgMax s' j → j = i
proof:
by
  apply argmax_unique s' i
  intro j hji
  have h1 : s' j ≤ s j + ε := by
    have h := hpert j
    rw [abs_le] at h
    linarith [h.2]
  have h2 : s i - ε ≤ s' i := by
    have h := hpert i
    rw [abs_le] at h
    linarith [h.1]
  have h3 := hgap j hji
  linarith

name: route_lipschitz
stmt:
theorem route_lipschitz (s s' : ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) (k : ℕ) (ε : ℝ)
    (hS : IsTopK s S k)
    (hpert : ∀ j, |s' j - s j| ≤ ε)
    (hchange : ¬ IsTopK s' S k) :
    ∃ i ∈ S, ∃ j, j ∉ S ∧ s i - s j < 2 * ε
proof:
by
  by_contra hcon
  have hcon' : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → 2 * ε ≤ s i - s j := by
    intro i hi j hj
    by_contra hlt
    push_neg at hlt
    exact hcon ⟨i, hi, j, hj, hlt⟩
  apply hchange
  refine topk_route_stable s s' S k (2 * ε) ε hS ?_ hpert le_rfl
  intro i hi j hj
  have h := hcon' i hi j hj
  linarith

stmt:

name: merge_output_bound
stmt:
theorem merge_output_bound {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (h : Fin k → F) (M : ℝ)
    (hα : ∀ i, 0 ≤ α i) (hsum : ∑ i, α i = 1) (hM : ∀ i, ‖h i‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖mergeHeads α h‖ ≤ M
proof:
by
  unfold mergeHeads
  calc
    ‖∑ i, α i • h i‖ ≤ ∑ i, ‖α i • h i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ i, α i * ‖h i‖ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hα i)]
    _ ≤ ∑ i, α i * M := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM i) (hα i)
    _ = M * (∑ i, α i) := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, mul_comm]
    _ = M := by rw [hsum, mul_one]

name: merge_output_bound_subprob
doc: 次概率权重（`Σ α ≤ 1`）的合并输出界：剪枝只减质量、不放大输出。
stmt:
theorem merge_output_bound_subprob {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (h : Fin k → F) (M : ℝ)
    (hα : ∀ i, 0 ≤ α i) (hα1 : ∑ i, α i ≤ 1) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M) (hM : ∀ i, ‖h i‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖mergeHeads α h‖ ≤ M
proof:
by
  unfold mergeHeads
  calc
    ‖∑ i, α i • h i‖ ≤ ∑ i, ‖α i • h i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ i, α i * ‖h i‖ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hα i)]
    _ ≤ ∑ i, α i * M := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM i) (hα i)
    _ = (∑ i, α i) * M := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    _ ≤ 1 * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hα1 hM0
    _ = M := one_mul M

name: mergeHeads_sub_smul_sum
doc: 合并减权的分解：`mergeHeads α h − (Σα) • h0 = Σ α i • (h i − h0)`。
stmt:
lemma mergeHeads_sub_smul_sum {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (h : Fin k → F) (h0 : F) :
    mergeHeads α h - (∑ i, α i) • h0 = ∑ i, α i • (h i - h0)
proof:
by
  unfold mergeHeads
  rw [Finset.sum_smul, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => (smul_sub (α i) (h i) h0).symm

name: head_redundancy_bound_subprob
doc:
次概率版冗余界：`‖mergeHeads α h − (Σα)•h0‖ ≤ (Σα)·ε`（`α ≥ 0`、
`∀i, ‖h i − h0‖ ≤ ε`）。
stmt:
theorem head_redundancy_bound_subprob {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (h : Fin k → F) (h0 : F)
    (ε : ℝ) (hα : ∀ i, 0 ≤ α i) (hε : ∀ i, ‖h i - h0‖ ≤ ε) :
    ‖mergeHeads α h - (∑ i, α i) • h0‖ ≤ (∑ i, α i) * ε
proof:
by
  rw [mergeHeads_sub_smul_sum]
  calc
    ‖∑ i, α i • (h i - h0)‖ ≤ ∑ i, ‖α i • (h i - h0)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ i, α i * ‖h i - h0‖ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hα i)]
    _ ≤ ∑ i, α i * ε := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hε i) (hα i)
    _ = (∑ i, α i) * ε := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]

name: head_redundancy_bound
doc:
**核心**：`α` 是概率分布（`Σα = 1`）且所有头与 `h0` 相差 ≤ ε ⟹
合并结果与 `h0` 的误差 ≤ ε（冗余头的合并不放大误差）。
stmt:
theorem head_redundancy_bound {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (h : Fin k → F) (h0 : F) (ε : ℝ)
    (hα : ∀ i, 0 ≤ α i) (hsum : ∑ i, α i = 1) (hε : ∀ i, ‖h i - h0‖ ≤ ε) :
    ‖mergeHeads α h - h0‖ ≤ ε
proof:
by
  have hmain := head_redundancy_bound_subprob α h h0 ε hα hε
  rwa [hsum, one_smul, one_mul] at hmain

name: head_pairwise_redundancy_bound
doc: 两两相近（都以第 `j` 头为参考）⟹ 合并到 `h j` 的误差 ≤ ε。
stmt:
theorem head_pairwise_redundancy_bound {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (h : Fin k → F) (j : Fin k)
    (ε : ℝ) (hα : ∀ i, 0 ≤ α i) (hsum : ∑ i, α i = 1) (hε : ∀ i, ‖h i - h j‖ ≤ ε) :
    ‖mergeHeads α h - h j‖ ≤ ε
proof: head_redundancy_bound α h (h j) ε hα hsum hε

name: merge_exact_when_identical
doc: 所有头恒等（都等于 `h0`）⟹ `mergeHeads α h = (Σα) • h0`。
stmt:
theorem merge_exact_when_identical {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (h : Fin k → F) (h0 : F)
    (hid : ∀ i, h i = h0) : mergeHeads α h = (∑ i, α i) • h0
proof:
by
  calc
    mergeHeads α h = ∑ i, α i • h0 := by
      unfold mergeHeads
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [hid i]
    _ = (∑ i, α i) • h0 := Finset.sum_smul.symm

name: merge_lossless_when_identical
doc: 所有头恒等且 `Σα = 1` ⟹ 合并**无损**：`mergeHeads α h = h0`。
stmt:
theorem merge_lossless_when_identical {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (h : Fin k → F) (h0 : F)
    (hid : ∀ i, h i = h0) (hsum : ∑ i, α i = 1) : mergeHeads α h = h0
proof:
by
  rw [merge_exact_when_identical α h h0 hid, hsum, one_smul]

name: pruned_head_mass_loss
doc: 丢头的权重和损失恰为 `α j`。
stmt:
theorem pruned_head_mass_loss {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (j : Fin k) :
    ∑ i, dropHead α j i = (∑ i, α i) - α j
proof:
by
  have hpoint : ∀ i : Fin k, dropHead α j i = α i - (if i = j then α i else 0) := by
    intro i
    unfold dropHead
    by_cases h : i = j
    · simp [h]
    · simp [h]
  calc
    ∑ i, dropHead α j i = ∑ i, (α i - (if i = j then α i else 0)) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hpoint i
    _ = (∑ i, α i) - ∑ i, (if i = j then α i else 0) := Finset.sum_sub_distrib
    _ = (∑ i, α i) - α j := by rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq', if_pos (Finset.mem_univ j)]

name: mergeHeads_sub_drop
doc: 丢头后的合并与完整合并之差恰为 `−α_j • h_j`。
stmt:
lemma mergeHeads_sub_drop {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (j : Fin k) (h : Fin k → F) :
    mergeHeads (dropHead α j) h - mergeHeads α h = -(α j) • h j
proof:
by
  unfold mergeHeads dropHead
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    simp [hb]
  · intro hj
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) hj

name: pruned_head_bound
doc: **剪头误差界**：丢掉第 `j` 头造成的输出差 ≤ `α_j · M`（该头权重 × 输出上界）。
stmt:
theorem pruned_head_bound {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (j : Fin k) (h : Fin k → F) (M : ℝ)
    (hαj : 0 ≤ α j) (hM : ∀ i, ‖h i‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖mergeHeads (dropHead α j) h - mergeHeads α h‖ ≤ α j * M
proof:
by
  rw [mergeHeads_sub_drop, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hαj]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM j) hαj

name: mergeHeadsOver_eq_mergeHeads

theorem mergeHeadsOver_eq_mergeHeads {k : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin k)) (α : Fin k → ℝ)

proof: rfl

name: pruned_head_output_bound
doc:
头剪枝（只保留 `S` 内的头、权重在 `S` 上和为 1）的输出界：
直接复用 `RealTopK.topk_output_bound`。
stmt:
theorem pruned_head_output_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (S : Finset ι) (α : ι → ℝ)
    (h : ι → F) (M : ℝ) (hα : ∀ i, i ∈ S → 0 ≤ α i) (hsum : ∑ i in S, α i = 1)
    (hM : ∀ i, ‖h i‖ ≤ M) : ‖mergeHeadsOver S α h‖ ≤ M
proof: topk_output_bound S α h M hα hsum hM

name: pruned_head_output_bound_subprob
doc: 头剪枝的次概率版：`Σ_{i∈S} α i ≤ 1` 时输出仍 ≤ M（`M ≥ 0`）。
stmt:
theorem pruned_head_output_bound_subprob {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (S : Finset ι) (α : ι → ℝ)
    (h : ι → F) (M : ℝ) (hα : ∀ i, i ∈ S → 0 ≤ α i) (hα1 : ∑ i in S, α i ≤ 1)
    (hM0 : 0 ≤ M) (hM : ∀ i, ‖h i‖ ≤ M) : ‖mergeHeadsOver S α h‖ ≤ M
proof:
by
  unfold mergeHeadsOver
  calc
    ‖∑ i in S, α i • h i‖ ≤ ∑ i in S, ‖α i • h i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ i in S, α i * ‖h i‖ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hα i hi)]
    _ ≤ ∑ i in S, α i * M :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM i) (hα i hi)
    _ = (∑ i in S, α i) * M := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    _ ≤ 1 * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hα1 hM0
    _ = M := one_mul M

end Lattice

name: headMass_le_topSum
doc:
**核心最优性（exchange argument）**：设 `S` 是质量最大的 `m` 个头
（`∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∉ S, μ j ≤ μ i`），则**任意**同基数的头集 `T`
满足 `headMass μ T ≤ headMass μ S`。

即「保留最大的 `m` 个头」在**所有**等预算方案中最优。证明直接是
`topK_sum_max`：令 `U = T \ S`、`V = S \ T`，两边基数相等；
取 `U` 中质量最大者 `i0`，逐项 `μ i ≤ μ i0 ≤ μ j`（`i ∈ U, j ∈ V`），
两段各 `|U| = |V|` 项配对即得 `∑_U μ ≤ ∑_V μ`，再由
`∑_T = ∑_{T∩S} + ∑_U`、`∑_S = ∑_{T∩S} + ∑_V` 收尾。
stmt:
theorem headMass_le_topSum (mu : ι → ℝ) {S T : Finset ι} (hcard : S.card = T.card)
    (htop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → mu j ≤ mu i) :
    headMass mu T ≤ headMass mu S
proof: topK_sum_max mu hcard htop

name: headMass_add_prunedMass
doc: **质量守恒**：`headMass μ T + prunedMass μ T = ∑ i, μ i`。
stmt:
theorem headMass_add_prunedMass (mu : ι → ℝ) (T : Finset ι) :
    headMass mu T + prunedMass mu T = ∑ i, mu i
proof:
by
  have h := Finset.sum_sdiff (f := mu) (Finset.subset_univ T)
  unfold headMass prunedMass
  simp only [Finset.sdiff_eq_filter] at h ⊢
  linarith

name: prunedMass_le_of_topSum
doc:
**丢弃质量最小（等价形式）**：取最大的 `m` 个时，被剪掉的质量
`prunedMass μ S ≤ prunedMass μ T` 对任意同基数 `T` 成立。

由质量守恒（保留 + 丢弃 = 总量，见 `headMass_add_prunedMass`）与
`headMass_le_topSum` 得到。
stmt:
theorem prunedMass_le_of_topSum (mu : ι → ℝ) {S T : Finset ι} (hcard : S.card = T.card)
    (htop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → mu j ≤ mu i) :
    prunedMass mu S ≤ prunedMass mu T
proof:
by
  have hS := headMass_add_prunedMass mu S
  have hT := headMass_add_prunedMass mu T
  have hle := headMass_le_topSum mu hcard htop
  linarith

name: greedy_is_optimal
doc:
**贪心最优性**：若 `S` 是最大的 `m` 个且 `T` 是任意同基数集，
则 `headMass μ S` 是**可达上确界**——即不存在比 `S` 更好的等预算方案。
stmt:
theorem greedy_is_optimal (mu : ι → ℝ) {S T : Finset ι} (hcard : S.card = T.card)
    (htop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → mu j ≤ mu i) :
    headMass mu T ≤ headMass mu S ∧ prunedMass mu S ≤ prunedMass mu T
proof: ⟨headMass_le_topSum mu hcard htop, prunedMass_le_of_topSum mu hcard htop⟩

name: uniform_head_case
doc:
**均匀头特例**：所有头质量相同时，**任意**两个同基数头集的保留质量相等——
即最优解**不唯一**（等质量任意选）。
stmt:
theorem uniform_head_case (c : ℝ) {S T : Finset ι} (hcard : S.card = T.card) :
    headMass (fun _ => c) T = headMass (fun _ => c) S
proof:
by
  unfold headMass
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.sum_const, hcard]

name: head_pruning_bound
doc:
**头剪枝误差界（核心）**：设 `∀i, ‖o i‖ ≤ M` 且质量非负，则
`‖prunedOutput μ o T − ∑ i, μ i • o i‖ ≤ M · prunedMass μ T`。

即**误差由被剪掉的质量控制**。差的精确分解为 `−∑_{i∉T} μ i • o i`。
stmt:
theorem head_pruning_bound (mu : ι → ℝ) (o : ι → F) (M : ℝ) (hM : ∀ i, ‖o i‖ ≤ M)
    (hmu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ mu i) (T : Finset ι) :
    ‖prunedOutput mu o T - ∑ i, mu i • o i‖ ≤ M * prunedMass mu T
proof:
by
  have hfull : ∑ i : ι, mu i • o i
      = ∑ i in T, mu i • o i + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, mu i • o i := by
    have h := Finset.sum_sdiff (f := fun i => mu i • o i) (Finset.subset_univ T)
    rw [Finset.sdiff_eq_filter] at h ⊢
    simp only [Finset.sum_filter] at h ⊢
    rw [← h]
    abel
  have hdec : prunedOutput mu o T - ∑ i, mu i • o i
      = ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, (-(mu i)) • o i := by
    have hneg : -(∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, mu i • o i)
        = ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, (-(mu i)) • o i := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [neg_smul]
    rw [show prunedOutput mu o T - ∑ i, mu i • o i
        = -(∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, mu i • o i) by
      rw [hfull]; unfold prunedOutput; abel]
    exact hneg
  rw [hdec]
  calc ‖∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, (-(mu i)) • o i‖
      ≤ ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, ‖(-(mu i)) • o i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, mu i * ‖o i‖ := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (hmu i)]
    _ ≤ ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, mu i * M := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM i) (hmu i)
    _ = M * prunedMass mu T := by
        unfold prunedMass
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring

name: head_pruning_optimal_bound
doc:
**最优误差界**：取质量最大的 `m` 个头时，误差界 `M · prunedMass μ S`
**不大于**任何同基数方案的误差界。
stmt:
theorem head_pruning_optimal_bound (mu : ι → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M)
    {S T : Finset ι} (hcard : S.card = T.card)
    (htop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → mu j ≤ mu i) :
    M * prunedMass mu S ≤ M * prunedMass mu T
proof: mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (prunedMass_le_of_topSum mu hcard htop) hM0

name: headMass_mono_budget
doc: **预算扩大不劣**：`S ⊆ S'`、质量非负 ⟹ `headMass μ S ≤ headMass μ S'`。
stmt:
theorem headMass_mono_budget (mu : ι → ℝ) (hmu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ mu i) {S S' : Finset ι}
    (hsub : S ⊆ S') : headMass mu S ≤ headMass mu S'
proof: Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub fun i _ _ => hmu i

name: retain_all_exact
doc: **满载精确性**：`T = univ`（保留全部头）时输出等于全输出，误差为 **0**。
stmt:
theorem retain_all_exact (mu : ι → ℝ) (o : ι → F) :
    prunedOutput mu o Finset.univ = ∑ i, mu i • o i
proof: rfl

name: prunedMass_univ
doc: **满载剪枝质量为零**：`prunedMass μ univ = 0`。
stmt: theorem prunedMass_univ (mu : ι → ℝ) : prunedMass mu (Finset.univ : Finset ι) = 0
proof:
by
  unfold prunedMass
  simp

name: retain_all_error_zero
doc: **满载误差为零**。
stmt:
theorem retain_all_error_zero (mu : ι → ℝ) (o : ι → F) :
    ‖prunedOutput mu o Finset.univ - ∑ i, mu i • o i‖ = 0
proof:
by
  rw [retain_all_exact, sub_self, norm_zero]

name: layer_wise_independent
doc:
**跨层独立最优（可加情形）**：设两层各有质量评分 `μ₁`、`μ₂`，
数据位于直积类型 `ι₁ × ι₂`，层内质量**加性**（`μ (i,j) = μ₁ i + μ₂ j`）。
若预算是 `(m₁, m₂)`（每层各保留 `m` 个），则**逐层**取 top-`m` 是全局最优。

本文件证明**加性分离**的关键等式：对任意 `T₁ × T₂`，
`headMass (μ₁ + μ₂) (T₁ ×ˢ T₂) = |T₂| · headMass μ₁ T₁ + |T₁| · headMass μ₂ T₂`
—— 即跨层质量是「层内质量 × 另一层基数」的线性组合，
故**逐层**最大化即全局最大化（两层的最优选择互不耦合）。

标注：这是「可加性 ⟹ 逐层最优 = 全局最优」的**充分**条件；
层间耦合（残差流）情形**未做**（见诚实边界）。
stmt:
theorem layer_wise_independent {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
    [DecidableEq ι₁] [DecidableEq ι₂] (mu₁ : ι₁ → ℝ) (mu₂ : ι₂ → ℝ)
    (T₁ : Finset ι₁) (T₂ : Finset ι₂) :
    headMass (fun p : ι₁ × ι₂ => mu₁ p.1 + mu₂ p.2) (T₁ ×ˢ T₂)
      = (T₂.card : ℝ) * headMass mu₁ T₁ + (T₁.card : ℝ) * headMass mu₂ T₂
proof:
by
  unfold headMass
  rw [Finset.sum_product]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  ·                                                   
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [Finset.sum_const]
    rw [nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  ·                                                   
    simp only [Finset.sum_const]
    rw [nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]

name: coupledLoss_zero_coupling
doc:
**可加退化（衔接 §五）**：`c = 0` 时耦合损失就是两层丢弃质量之和
——即 `layer_wise_independent` 的加性假设在这个模型里就是 `c = 0`。
stmt:
theorem coupledLoss_zero_coupling (D1 D2 : ℝ) :
    coupledLoss 0 D1 D2 = D1 + D2
proof:
by
  unfold coupledLoss; ring

name: layerwise_optimal_not_global
doc:
**逐层最优 ≠ 全局最优（核心反例，精确有理数）**：取 `c = -3`，
两层各有两个可选头、其丢弃质量分别为 `1/10` 与 `9/10`。

- **逐层最优**：两层都选「丢弃质量最小」的方案 `(D₁, D₂) = (1/10, 1/10)`，
  给 `coupledLoss = 17/100`；
- **全局最优**：两层都选「丢弃质量最大」的方案 `(9/10, 9/10)`，
  给 `coupledLoss = -63/100 < 17/100`。

故**逐层最小化丢弃质量得到的解不是全局最优解**——残差流的（强）抵消耦合
（`c = -3`）使「故意多丢一点」反而显著降低总损失。

这说明 `RealHeadPruningOptimal` 的逐层最优性（`headMass_le_topSum`）
**不能**直接升为跨层最优性，除非层间耦合可加（§五）。
反例的全部数字都是有理数，可由内核 `norm_num` 直接验证。
stmt:
theorem layerwise_optimal_not_global :
    coupledLoss (-3) (1/10) (1/10) = 17/100 ∧
    coupledLoss (-3) (9/10) (9/10) = -63/100 ∧
    coupledLoss (-3) (9/10) (9/10) < coupledLoss (-3) (1/10) (1/10)
proof: ⟨by norm_num [coupledLoss], by norm_num [coupledLoss], by norm_num [coupledLoss]⟩

name: layerwise_optimal_is_global_worst
doc:
**反例的完整 2×2 表**：`(9/10, 9/10)` **严格优于**其余三个组合
——即全局最优不仅是「不等于逐层最优」，而是**恰好取在逐层最劣的方向上**。

这是比 `layerwise_optimal_not_global` 更强的陈述：反例不是边界平局，
而是**严格反转**（逐层最优是全局最劣）。
stmt:
theorem layerwise_optimal_is_global_worst :
    coupledLoss (-3) (9/10) (9/10) < coupledLoss (-3) (1/10) (1/10) ∧
    coupledLoss (-3) (9/10) (9/10) < coupledLoss (-3) (1/10) (9/10) ∧
    coupledLoss (-3) (9/10) (9/10) < coupledLoss (-3) (9/10) (1/10)
proof: ⟨by norm_num [coupledLoss], by norm_num [coupledLoss], by norm_num [coupledLoss]⟩

name: coupledLoss_strictAnti_on_negative
doc:
**非加性失效的阈值（核心，联合最优条件）**：交叉项使联合损失关于
**单层**丢弃质量**非单调**——`∂/∂D₁ (D₁ + D₂ + c D₁ D₂) = 1 + c·D₂`，
故当 `D₂ > -1/c`（`c < 0`）时**增大** `D₁` 反而**降低**总损失。

形式化：`c < 0` 且 `1 + c·D₂ < 0` 时，`D₁ ↦ coupledLoss c D₁ D₂` **严格递减**。
这就是「逐层最优 ≠ 全局最优」的**充要机制**：只要存在一层使
`1 + c·D_other < 0`，该层的「越小越好」直觉就失效。

**联合最优条件**（本模型下）：`c ≥ 0` 时，
`1 + c·D₂ ≥ 1 > 0`、`1 + c·D₁ ≥ 1 > 0`，两方向都单调递增，
故**逐层最小化丢弃质量 = 全局最优**（可加分离在 `c ≥ 0` 时仍然有效，
尽管损失函数本身非加性）。`c < 0` 时分离可能失效（见上两条反例）。
stmt:
theorem coupledLoss_strictAnti_on_negative (c D1 D1' D2 : ℝ)
    (h : 1 + c * D2 < 0) (hlt : D1 < D1') :
    coupledLoss c D1' D2 < coupledLoss c D1 D2
proof:
by
  unfold coupledLoss
  have : (D1' - D1) * (1 + c * D2) < 0 :=
    mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by linarith) h
  nlinarith

name: layerwise_optimal_of_nonneg_coupling
doc:
**`c ≥ 0` 时逐层最优仍是全局最优（联合最优的充分条件，核心）**：
残差耦合非负（放大型）时，联合损失关于每一层的丢弃质量**单调不减**
（`1 + c·D₂ ≥ 1 > 0`，需 `D₂ ≥ 0`），
故「两层都取各自最小丢弃质量」是全局最优——**可加分离在放大耦合下依然成立**。

这给出精确的分界：**耦合的符号**决定逐层最优是否全局最优
（`c ≥ 0`：是；`c < 0`：未必，见 `layerwise_optimal_not_global`）。
stmt:
theorem layerwise_optimal_of_nonneg_coupling (c D1 D1' D2 : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hD2 : 0 ≤ D2) (hlt : D1 ≤ D1') :
    coupledLoss c D1 D2 ≤ coupledLoss c D1' D2
proof:
by
  unfold coupledLoss
  have h1 : 0 ≤ 1 + c * D2 := by nlinarith
  nlinarith

name: retrainedMass_eq_smul
doc: **补偿是线性的**：`retrainedMass ρ μ T = (1-ρ) · headMass μ T`。
stmt:
theorem retrainedMass_eq_smul (rho : ℝ) (mu : ι → ℝ) (T : Finset ι) :
    retrainedMass rho mu T = (1 - rho) * headMass mu T
proof:
by
  unfold retrainedMass headMass
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: retrained_headMass_le_topSum
doc:
**补偿不改变最优头的选择（核心）**：`ρ < 1` 时，
「原始质量最大的 `m` 个头」**仍然**是补偿后质量最大的 `m` 个
——即**对角重训练不改变剪枝决策**，只等比缩小误差界。

这是简化模型的**关键结论**：既然补偿对每个保留头施加**同一**因子 `(1-ρ)`，
排序不变，故 §二 的最优性（`headMass_le_topSum`）**原样转移**到补偿后的设定。
（真实重训练是非对角的，会改变排序——该情形**未做**。）
stmt:
theorem retrained_headMass_le_topSum (rho : ℝ) (mu : ι → ℝ) (hrho : rho < 1)
    {S T : Finset ι} (hcard : S.card = T.card)
    (htop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → mu j ≤ mu i) :
    retrainedMass rho mu T ≤ retrainedMass rho mu S
proof:
by
  rw [retrainedMass_eq_smul, retrainedMass_eq_smul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (headMass_le_topSum mu hcard htop) (by linarith)

name: retraining_improves_bound
doc:
**补偿缩小误差界（定量）**：补偿率越大（`ρ₁ ≤ ρ₂`），
同一保留集的**有效丢弃质量**越小，故误差界越紧。

形式化：质量非负时 `(1-ρ₂)·prunedMass ≤ (1-ρ₁)·prunedMass`
——**重训练单调地改进误差界**（不需要 `ρ₂ ≤ 1` 的额外假设）。
stmt:
theorem retraining_improves_bound (mu : ι → ℝ) (hmu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ mu i) (T : Finset ι)
    {rho1 rho2 : ℝ} (h12 : rho1 ≤ rho2) :
    (1 - rho2) * prunedMass mu T ≤ (1 - rho1) * prunedMass mu T
proof:
by
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ ?_
  · linarith
  · unfold prunedMass
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hmu i

end Lattice.Lib.Attention.RealHeadPruningOptimal

name: block_rotate_preserves_dot
stmt:
theorem block_rotate_preserves_dot {d : ℕ} (θ : Fin d → ℝ) (u v : Fin d → Point2R) :
    blockDot (blockRotate θ u) (blockRotate θ v) = blockDot u v
proof:
by
  unfold blockDot
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro i _
  exact rotate_preserves_dot (θ i) (u i) (v i)

name: block_rotate_compose
stmt:
theorem block_rotate_compose {d : ℕ} (a b : Fin d → ℝ) (u : Fin d → Point2R) :
    blockRotate a (blockRotate b u) = blockRotate (fun i => a i + b i) u
proof:
by
  funext i
  exact rotate_compose (a i) (b i) (u i)

name: block_rotate_preserves_normSq
stmt:
theorem block_rotate_preserves_normSq {d : ℕ} (θ : Fin d → ℝ) (u : Fin d → Point2R) :
    blockNormSq (blockRotate θ u) = blockNormSq u
proof: block_rotate_preserves_dot θ u u

name: block_rotate_preserves_norm
doc: 分块旋转保（平方范数的）范数 `‖BlockRotate(θ)u‖ = ‖u‖`。
stmt:
theorem block_rotate_preserves_norm {d : ℕ} (θ : Fin d → ℝ) (u : Fin d → Point2R) :
    blockNorm (blockRotate θ u) = blockNorm u
proof:
by
  unfold blockNorm
  rw [block_rotate_preserves_normSq]

name: block_rope_isometry
stmt:
theorem block_rope_isometry {d : ℕ} (m p : ℝ) (θ : Fin d → ℝ) (u : Fin d → Point2R) :
    blockNormSq (blockRotate (fun i => (p - m) * θ i) u) = blockNormSq u
proof:
block_rotate_preserves_normSq (fun i => (p - m) * θ i) u

end Lattice

name: retainedMass_le_topSum
doc:
**核心最优性（交换论证）**：设 `S` 是权重最大的 `m` 项
（`∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∉ S, w j ≤ w i`），则**任意**与 `S` 同基数的保留集 `T`
满足 `retainedMass w T ≤ retainedMass w S`。

即「保留最大的 `m` 个」在**所有**等预算方案中最优。证明直接是
`topK_sum_max`（交换论证：取 `T \ S` 中权重最大者 `i0`，
逐项配对 `w i ≤ w i0 ≤ w j`）。
stmt:
theorem retainedMass_le_topSum (w : ι → ℝ) {S T : Finset ι} (hcard : S.card = T.card)
    (htop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → w j ≤ w i) :
    retainedMass w T ≤ retainedMass w S
proof: topK_sum_max w hcard htop

name: retainedMass_add_droppedMass
doc:
**质量守恒**：`retainedMass w T + droppedMass w T = ∑ i, w i`。

保留与丢弃恰好划分全集（与 `RealBlockSparseExact` 的
`maskCount_add_compl_eq_total` 在实数求和上的对应形式）。

**注意：R3 更正（悬空引用）**：`RealBlockSparseExact` **不在本文件的 import 闭包内**
（本文件只 `import Mathlib` / `RealKVCache` / `RealTopKExistence`），
故上述只是**跨模块的文字类比**，本文件**未** import 该模块、**未**使用其任何引理；
本定理的证明**完全自足**（只用 `Finset.sum_sdiff` / `Finset.sum_filter`）。
stmt:
theorem retainedMass_add_droppedMass (w : ι → ℝ) (T : Finset ι) :
    retainedMass w T + droppedMass w T = ∑ i, w i
proof:
by
  have h := Finset.sum_sdiff (f := w) (Finset.subset_univ T)
  unfold retainedMass droppedMass
  simp only [Finset.sdiff_eq_filter] at h ⊢
  linarith

name: droppedMass_nonneg
doc: **丢弃质量非负**：权重非负时 `0 ≤ droppedMass w T`。
stmt:
theorem droppedMass_nonneg (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (T : Finset ι) :
    0 ≤ droppedMass w T
proof: Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hw i

name: droppedMass_eq_zero_iff
doc: **丢弃质量为 0 的刻画**：权重非负时 `droppedMass w T = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∉ T, w i = 0`。
stmt:
theorem droppedMass_eq_zero_iff (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (T : Finset ι) :
    droppedMass w T = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∉ T, w i = 0
proof:
by
  unfold droppedMass
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ => hw i)]
  constructor
  · intro h i hi
    exact h i (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hi⟩)
  · intro h i hi
    exact h i (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hi).2

name: budgetError_bound
doc:
**预算误差界（核心）**：设 `∀i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M` 且全集的权重和为 `Wtot`，
则用保留集 `T` 近似的误差满足
`‖budgetOutput w v T − ∑ i, w i • v i‖ ≤ M · droppedMass w T`。

即**误差由丢弃质量控制**——把注意力质量集中在少数条目上就足够精确。
证明：差等于 `∑_{i∉T} w i • v i`，逐项用 `‖w i • v i‖ = w i · ‖v i‖ ≤ w i · M`
（权重非负），再由三角不等式提出。

标注：这里的差**恰好**是丢弃部分的加权和（精确分解，非估计）。
stmt:
theorem budgetError_bound (w : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → F) (M : ℝ) (hM : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (T : Finset ι) :
    ‖budgetOutput w v T - ∑ i, w i • v i‖ ≤ M * droppedMass w T
proof:
by
                                           
  have hfull : ∑ i : ι, w i • v i
      = ∑ i in T, w i • v i + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, w i • v i := by
    have h := Finset.sum_sdiff (f := fun i => w i • v i) (Finset.subset_univ T)
    rw [Finset.sdiff_eq_filter] at h ⊢
    simp only [Finset.sum_filter] at h ⊢
    rw [← h]
    abel
  have hdec : budgetOutput w v T - ∑ i, w i • v i
      = ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, (-(w i)) • v i := by
    have hneg : -(∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, w i • v i)
        = ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, (-(w i)) • v i := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [neg_smul]
    rw [show budgetOutput w v T - ∑ i, w i • v i
        = -(∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, w i • v i) by
      rw [hfull]; unfold budgetOutput; abel]
    exact hneg
  rw [hdec]
  calc ‖∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, (-(w i)) • v i‖
      ≤ ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, ‖(-(w i)) • v i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, w i * ‖v i‖ := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (hw i)]
    _ ≤ ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, w i * M := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM i) (hw i)
    _ = M * droppedMass w T := by
        unfold droppedMass
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring

name: droppedMass_le_of_topSum
doc:
**最优误差界**：若 `S` 是最大的 `m` 项、`T` 是任意同基数的保留集，
则 `droppedMass w S ≤ droppedMass w T`，从而**最优方案的误差界最小**。

由质量守恒（保留 + 丢弃 = 总量）与 `retainedMass_le_topSum` 得到。
stmt:
theorem droppedMass_le_of_topSum (w : ι → ℝ) {S T : Finset ι} (hcard : S.card = T.card)
    (htop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → w j ≤ w i) :
    droppedMass w S ≤ droppedMass w T
proof:
by
  have hS := retainedMass_add_droppedMass w S
  have hT := retainedMass_add_droppedMass w T
  have hle := retainedMass_le_topSum w hcard htop
  linarith

name: optimal_error_bound
doc:
**最优误差界（组合形式）**：`S` 为最大的 `m` 项时，
任何同基数 `T` 的误差界 `M · droppedMass w T` 都**不小于** `M · droppedMass w S`。

**v15 更正（删除装饰性形参 `v`）**：原陈述带形参 `v : ι → F`，但证明体从不使用它
（Lean 未报 `unused variable` 是因为 `v` 出现于**陈述**中的…事实上它**不出现在结论里**；
经逐行核对，`v` 对本命题完全无贡献）。已**删除**——命题强度**不变**。
（下游无调用方按位置传参，见全库 grep。）
stmt:
theorem optimal_error_bound (w : ι → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M)
    {S T : Finset ι} (hcard : S.card = T.card)
    (htop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → w j ≤ w i) :
    M * droppedMass w S ≤ M * droppedMass w T
proof: mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (droppedMass_le_of_topSum w hcard htop) hM0

name: retainedMass_mono_budget
doc:
**预算越大越好（保留质量单调）**：若 `S ⊆ S'` 且权重非负，
则 `retainedMass w S ≤ retainedMass w S'`。
stmt:
theorem retainedMass_mono_budget (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) {S S' : Finset ι}
    (hsub : S ⊆ S') : retainedMass w S ≤ retainedMass w S'
proof: Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub fun i _ _ => hw i

name: full_budget_exact
doc:
**满载精确性**：`T = univ` 时丢弃质量为 `0`，误差为 `0`
——回收 `RealKVCache` 的「无预算限制 ⟹ 精确」结论。

**v15 更正**：原陈述带形参 `v : ι → F`，但证明体是 `rfl`（对 `univ` 取和即原式），
与 `v` 的具体取值无关——`v` 是**签名对齐用**的装饰性形参，已改名为 `_v` 以显式标注
（结论里的 `v` 仍是被全称绑定的自由变量，命题不变）。
stmt:
theorem full_budget_exact (w : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → F) :
    budgetOutput w v Finset.univ = ∑ i, w i • v i
proof:
by
  unfold budgetOutput
  rfl

name: droppedMass_univ
doc: **满载丢弃质量为零**：`droppedMass w univ = 0`。
stmt: theorem droppedMass_univ (w : ι → ℝ) : droppedMass w (Finset.univ : Finset ι) = 0
proof:
by
  unfold droppedMass
  simp

name: full_budget_error_zero
doc:
**满载误差为零**：`T = univ` 时 `budgetError_bound` 的左端为 `0`。

**v15 更正**：原陈述带形参 `v : ι → F` 且**结论含 `v`**（`‖budgetOutput w v univ −
∑ i, w i • v i‖ = 0`）。Lean **未**把 `v` 报为 `unused`（它出现在结论中），
故 `v` **保留**——它是**全称量化**的实参（对**每个** `v` 误差都为 `0`，
这正是「满载 ⟹ 精确」的内容）。证明用 `full_budget_exact w v` 消去 `budgetOutput`
再由 `sub_self` 得 `0`。
stmt:
theorem full_budget_error_zero (w : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → F) :
    ‖budgetOutput w v Finset.univ - ∑ i, w i • v i‖ = 0
proof:
by
  rw [full_budget_exact, sub_self, norm_zero]

name: budget_error_sharp_zero
doc:
**`m = 0` 的紧性见证（退化）**：空保留集 `T = ∅` 的丢弃质量等于**全部**质量，
故误差界 `M · ∑ i, w i` 可达（取所有 `v i` 同向、`‖v i‖ = M`）。

标注：这是**退化**（`m = 0`，即完全不缓存）的紧性；
一般 `m` 下误差界的**锐性（下界）未做**（见诚实边界）。

**v15 更正（删除装饰性前提）**：原陈述带形参 `v`、假设 `hM`（`∀i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M`）
与 `hw`（权重非负），但 Lean 报 **`unused variable 'hM'` 与 `'hw'`**
（`v` 亦被整个丢弃）——结论只是 `droppedMass w ∅ = ∑ i, w i`
（**定义级别的恒等式**，由 `Finset.univ \ ∅ = univ` 即得），**不需要任何假设**。
原陈述因此**虚构了前提**（与「锐性」相关的三条假设其实属 §六 的对抗向量论证，
不属于本恒等式）。已**删除**三者，命题变为**无条件**形式——更诚实且**严格更强**。
stmt:
theorem budget_error_sharp_zero (w : ι → ℝ) :
    droppedMass w (∅ : Finset ι) = ∑ i, w i
proof:
by
  unfold droppedMass
  simp

name: budget_error_zero_budget
doc: **`m = 0` 时误差界即总质量界**：`‖0 − ∑ i, w i • v i‖ ≤ M · ∑ i, w i`。
stmt:
theorem budget_error_zero_budget (w : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → F) (M : ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) :
    ‖budgetOutput w v (∅ : Finset ι) - ∑ i, w i • v i‖ ≤ M * ∑ i, w i
proof:
by
  have h := budgetError_bound w v M hM hw (∅ : Finset ι)
  rwa [budget_error_sharp_zero w] at h

name: norm_adversarialVec
doc: **对抗向量的范数恰为 `M`**（`M ≥ 0`）——即它落在假设类 `‖v i‖ ≤ M` 的**边界**上。
stmt:
theorem norm_adversarialVec (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (i : ι) :
    ‖adversarialVec (ι := ι) M i‖ = M
proof:
by
  rw [adversarialVec, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hM]

name: smul_adversarialVec
doc: **加权贡献恒为 `−(M * w i)`**：`w i • v i = −(M * w i)`（标量模型）。
stmt:
theorem smul_adversarialVec (w : ι → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (i : ι) :
    w i • adversarialVec (ι := ι) M i = -(M * w i)
proof:
by
  rw [adversarialVec, smul_neg, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: sharpness_witness_uniform
doc:
**锐性见证（上界侧，核心）**：`w ≥ 0`、`M ≥ 0` 时，对抗向量 `v := −M` 使

    `‖budgetOutput w v S − ∑ i, w i • v i‖ = M · droppedMass w S`

——即 `budgetError_bound` 的**左端取到右端**（不等号变等号）。

**意义**：这条定理把 `budgetError_bound` 的**单向**上界升级为**双向**：
界在该实例上**恰被达到**，故 `M · droppedMass` 是**最优常数形式**，不可能改进
（若换成 `M' < M`，本实例即为反例，见 §七 `not_optConstant_lt`）。
stmt:
theorem sharpness_witness_uniform (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (S : Finset ι) :
    ‖budgetOutput w (adversarialVec (ι := ι) M) S
        - ∑ i, w i • adversarialVec (ι := ι) M i‖ = M * droppedMass w S
proof:
by
  have hpart : budgetOutput w (adversarialVec (ι := ι) M) S = -(M * ∑ i in S, w i) := by
    unfold budgetOutput
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => smul_adversarialVec w M i), Finset.sum_neg_distrib,
      Finset.mul_sum]
  have hfull : ∑ i, w i • adversarialVec (ι := ι) M i = -(M * ∑ i, w i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => smul_adversarialVec w M i), Finset.sum_neg_distrib,
      Finset.mul_sum]
  have htot : (∑ i, w i) = (∑ i in S, w i) + droppedMass w S := by
    have h := retainedMass_add_droppedMass w S
    unfold retainedMass at h
    linarith
  have hdropped : 0 ≤ droppedMass w S := droppedMass_nonneg w hw S
  have hdiff : budgetOutput w (adversarialVec (ι := ι) M) S
      - ∑ i, w i • adversarialVec (ι := ι) M i = M * droppedMass w S := by
    rw [hpart, hfull]
    rw [show -(M * (∑ i in S, w i)) - -(M * ∑ i, w i)
        = M * ((∑ i, w i) - ∑ i in S, w i) from by ring]
    rw [htot]
    ring
  rw [hdiff, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hM hdropped)]

name: optConstant_self
doc:
**界本身是最优常数的候选**：`OptConstant w M S M`——直接就是
`budgetError_bound`（在 `w ≥ 0` 下）。

**v15 更正（删除装饰性前提）**：本定理原带形参 `v₀ : ι → F` 与假设
`hMv : ∀ i, ‖v₀ i‖ ≤ M`，但**证明体从不使用二者**（Lean 报
`unused variable 'hMv'`；`v₀` 亦被整个丢弃）——而 `OptConstant` 对**任意**
满足 `∀i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M` 的 `v` 都断言界成立，故这两个前提是**纯装饰**：
对任意 `v₀`（含不满足 `hMv` 者）命题强度完全相同。已**删除**，命题变为
**更诚实且严格更强**的形式（无需为调用方提供见证向量）。
`v` 是 `OptConstant` **内部**全称量化的变量，由 `fun v hv => …` 立即绑定。

**v15 更正之二（`hM : 0 ≤ M`）**：Lean 亦报 `unused variable 'hM'`——
`budgetError_bound` 的界对**任意实 `M`** 成立（其证明用 `mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left`
时以 `hw` 逐项放缩，`M` 的符号不进入），故 `hM` 同为装饰性前提，已**删除**。
stmt:
theorem optConstant_self (w : ι → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (S : Finset ι) :
    OptConstant (F := F) w M S M
proof: fun v hv => budgetError_bound w v M hv hw S

name: optConstant_eq_of_witness
doc:
**由取等见证导出「最优常数恰为 `M`」（充要）**：若存在一条满足
`∀i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M` 的实例使不等号**取等**，且**丢弃质量非零**
（`droppedMass w S ≠ 0`），则

    `OptConstant w M S c ↔ M ≤ c`。

左边 ⟹ 右边：取等实例上 `M · droppedMass w S = ‖error‖ ≤ c · droppedMass w S`，
故 `M ≤ c`（`droppedMass > 0` 时约去）。
右边 ⟹ 左边：`c · droppedMass ≥ M · droppedMass`，故 `budgetError_bound` 提升为 `c` 版。

**`droppedMass ≠ 0` 前提是本质的（诚实标注）**：`droppedMass = 0`（满载缓存）时
误差恒为 `0`，界 `c · 0 = 0` 对**任意** `c`（含负数）都成立，
此时「最优常数」**退化**——`c ≥ M` **不**从界面推出。故本定理显式要求非退化。

**这是本文件最重要的双向结果**：它把「误差界」从单向上界升级为
「**`M` 是最优常数，改进不可能**」。

**v15 更正（删除多余假设 `hM`）**：原陈述带 `hM : 0 ≤ M`，但 Lean 报
`unused variable 'hM'`——证明的两个方向都只用 `droppedMass_nonneg` 给出的
`0 ≤ droppedMass w S`（约去正因子与 `linarith` 均不需要 `M` 的非负性），
`hM` 是**纯装饰前提**，已**删除**（命题强度不变，但少一个虚构前提）。
stmt:
theorem optConstant_eq_of_witness (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (M : ℝ)
    {S : Finset ι} (hS : droppedMass w S ≠ 0)
    (v : ι → F) (hv : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M)
    (heq : ‖budgetOutput w v S - ∑ i, w i • v i‖ = M * droppedMass w S) (c : ℝ) :
    OptConstant (F := F) w M S c ↔ M ≤ c
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hopt
    have hd0 : 0 ≤ droppedMass w S := droppedMass_nonneg w hw S
    have hdpos : 0 < droppedMass w S := lt_of_le_of_ne hd0 (Ne.symm hS)
    have h := hopt v hv
    rw [heq] at h
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h hdpos
  · intro hc v' hv'
    have hd0 : 0 ≤ droppedMass w S := droppedMass_nonneg w hw S
    have h1 := budgetError_bound w v' M hv' hw S
    have h2 : M * droppedMass w S ≤ c * droppedMass w S :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc hd0
    linarith

name: optConstant_lower_bound
doc:
**下界方向**：若存在取等见证（且丢弃质量非零），则任何有效的最优常数 `c` 必须 `≥ M`
——即 `M · droppedMass w S` 是**信息类内不可改进**的误差保证。

**v15 更正**：删除**从未被证明使用**的 `hM : 0 ≤ M`（Lean 报 `unused variable 'hM'`）。
stmt:
theorem optConstant_lower_bound (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (M : ℝ)
    {S : Finset ι} (hS : droppedMass w S ≠ 0) (v : ι → F) (hv : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M)
    (heq : ‖budgetOutput w v S - ∑ i, w i • v i‖ = M * droppedMass w S)
    {c : ℝ} (hopt : OptConstant (F := F) w M S c) : M ≤ c
proof: (optConstant_eq_of_witness w hw M hS v hv heq c).mp hopt

name: not_optConstant_lt
doc:
**改进不可能（反例形式，最直白的下界陈述）**：若存在取等见证且
`droppedMass w S ≠ 0`，则**任何** `c < M` 都不是有效的 M-类误差常数
——即把 `M` 换成更小的常数必然出现反例。

前提 `droppedMass ≠ 0` 是本质的：丢弃质量为 0（满载缓存）时误差恒为 0，
任何常数（含负数）都是有效上界，这时「最优常数」退化（**标注**）。

**v15 更正**：删除**从未被证明使用**的 `hM : 0 ≤ M`（Lean 报 `unused variable 'hM'`）。
stmt:
theorem not_optConstant_lt (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (M : ℝ)
    {S : Finset ι} (hS : droppedMass w S ≠ 0) (v : ι → F) (hv : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M)
    (heq : ‖budgetOutput w v S - ∑ i, w i • v i‖ = M * droppedMass w S)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : c < M) : ¬ OptConstant (F := F) w M S c
proof:
by
  intro hopt
  have hd0 : 0 ≤ droppedMass w S := droppedMass_nonneg w hw S
  have hdpos : 0 < droppedMass w S := lt_of_le_of_ne hd0 (Ne.symm hS)
  have hle := hopt v hv
  rw [heq] at hle
  have hmul : c * droppedMass w S < M * droppedMass w S :=
    mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hc hdpos
  linarith

name: sharpness_witness_const_weights
doc:
**`m = 1` 的锐性见证（通用基数，非退化）**：取**任意** `ι`、**任意**保留集 `S`、
权重恒为 `1`、`M = 1`。则

    `‖budgetOutput w v S − ∑ i, w i • v i‖ = 1 · droppedMass w S`。

其中 `v := adversarialVec 1`（恒为 `−1`）满足 `‖v i‖ = 1`（落在假设类边界）。

**这是「只保留部分项」情形的完整非退化锐性见证**：
`droppedMass w S = |ι| − |S|`（只要 `S ≠ univ` 即 `> 0`），界两端**均为正**。
特别地 `|ι| = 2`、`S = {单点}` 即 `m = 1`、`n = 2` 的最小实例（`droppedMass = 1`）。
stmt:
theorem sharpness_witness_const_weights (S : Finset ι) :
    ‖budgetOutput (fun _ : ι => (1 : ℝ)) (adversarialVec (ι := ι) 1) S
        - ∑ i : ι, (1 : ℝ) • adversarialVec (ι := ι) 1 i‖
      = 1 * droppedMass (fun _ : ι => (1 : ℝ)) S
proof:
sharpness_witness_uniform (fun _ : ι => (1 : ℝ)) (fun _ => zero_le_one) 1
    zero_le_one S

name: sharpness_witness_two_nonzero
doc:
**`m = 1`、`n = 2` 的最小非退化实例**：`ι = Fin 2`、权重恒为 `1`、`M = 1`、
保留集 `S = {0}`，则 `droppedMass = 1` 且误差恰为 `1`。

**标注**：这里的对抗向量由 §六 的构造 `adversarialVec` 给出（不是手写的
`if` 表达式），因此**自动**落在 `budgetError_bound` 的假设类内；显式的
`droppedMass = 1` 与 `‖v 0‖ = 1` 另行机器验证。
stmt:
theorem sharpness_witness_two_nonzero :
    droppedMass (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 : ℝ)) {(0 : Fin 2)} = 1
      ∧ ‖adversarialVec (ι := Fin 2) 1 (0 : Fin 2)‖ = 1
      ∧ ‖budgetOutput (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 : ℝ)) (adversarialVec (ι := Fin 2) 1) {(0 : Fin 2)}
          - ∑ i : Fin 2, (1 : ℝ) • adversarialVec (ι := Fin 2) 1 i‖ = 1 * 1
proof:
by
  have hd : droppedMass (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 : ℝ)) {(0 : Fin 2)} = 1 := by
    unfold droppedMass
    rw [show (Finset.univ \ ({(0 : Fin 2)} : Finset (Fin 2))) = {(1 : Fin 2)} from by decide]
    simp
  have hn : ‖adversarialVec (ι := Fin 2) 1 (0 : Fin 2)‖ = 1 :=
    norm_adversarialVec 1 zero_le_one (0 : Fin 2)
  have hw := sharpness_witness_const_weights (ι := Fin 2) {(0 : Fin 2)}
  rw [hd] at hw
  exact ⟨hd, hn, hw⟩

name: sharpness_witness_empty
doc:
**`m = 0` 的锐性见证（升级版）**：`S = ∅` 时对任意 `N`，误差
`= M · ∑ i, w i`——即 §五 的退化见证其实是 §六 一般构造的特例
（`droppedMass w ∅ = ∑ i, w i`）。
stmt:
theorem sharpness_witness_empty (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    ‖budgetOutput w (adversarialVec (ι := ι) M) (∅ : Finset ι)
        - ∑ i, w i • adversarialVec (ι := ι) M i‖ = M * ∑ i, w i
proof:
by
  rw [sharpness_witness_uniform w hw M hM (∅ : Finset ι)]
  congr 1
  unfold droppedMass
  simp

name: cache_size_eq_processed
doc: 缓存长度的定义式展开（已处理 token 数）。
stmt: theorem cache_size_eq_processed {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : cacheLength i = i.val + 1
proof: rfl
